Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for survivor radio broadcasts, dynamic SOS contracts, supply drops, and town recon.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_BroadcastIntervalM: Real minutes between automatic survivor, outpost, and caravan radio broadcasts.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_SOSContractInterva: Real minutes between new survivor SOS beacons and field rescue contracts.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_SOSTimeoutMinutes_: How long an SOS distress beacon stays active before expiring.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_RewardMultiplier_t: Scales physical item rewards granted for completing SOS contracts (100 is standard).
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_SupplyDispatchCool: Waiting time in real minutes between radio supply drop requests per player.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_IntelCooldownMinut: Waiting time in real minutes between tactical town recon requests per player.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_AutoMapMarkers_too: Automatically add map annotations for intercepted broadcasts and SOS beacons when the player carries a pen or pencil.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_RequirePoweredRadi: Require a turned-on, powered radio (in inventory, hands, nearby, or vehicle) to intercept airwaves and transmit.
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_EmergencyFreqKhz_t: Frequency in Hz for the Knox Survivor Emergency channel (94200 is 94.2 MHz).
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_TradeFreqKhz_toolt: Frequency in Hz for the Caravan, Outpost, and Supply Dispatch channel (101600 is 101.6 MHz).
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_TacticalFreqKhz_to: Frequency in Hz for the Tactical and Town Recon channel (106400 is 106.4 MHz).
Sandbox_ALifeAirwaves_Debug_tooltip: Print detailed [ALA] diagnostics to the console log.
